mechanism: Hydroxychloroquine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing eplerenone plasma concentrations and increasing hyperkalemia risk; both drugs can prolong QT interval and cause cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and ECG periodically; consider baseline and follow-up potassium and renal function assessment; dose adjustment of eplerenone may be needed if CYP3A4 inhibition is significant.
